function.name: containers.List
function.description: List the containers that belong to this agent's sandbox.

function.name: containers.Images
function.description: List the locally available container images that are allowed for this agent.

function.name: containers.Create
function.description: Create and start a detached container, mounting the sandbox at /workspace. The image must be listed by containers.Images.

name.description: Unique container name using letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes. Must not start with a dash.

command.description: Optional command to keep the container running. Defaults to "sleep" with the argument "infinity".

arguments.description: Optional arguments for command. Only valid when command is set.

network.description: Container network mode. "bridge" provides outbound network access, "none" disables networking.

function.name: containers.Stat
function.description: Show ID, image, state and start time for one container in this sandbox.

name.description: Container name, as returned by containers.List.

function.name: containers.Start
function.description: Start a stopped container in this sandbox.

name.description: Container name, as returned by containers.List.

function.name: containers.Stop
function.description: Stop a running container in this sandbox.

name.description: Container name, as returned by containers.List.

function.name: containers.Remove
function.description: Force-remove a container in this sandbox.

name.description: Container name, as returned by containers.List.

function.name: containers.Exec
function.description: Execute a command inside a running container and return its stdout and stderr. No shell is used.

name.description: Container name, as returned by containers.List.

command.description: Command to execute inside the container, e.g. "sh" or "/bin/ls".

arguments.description: Optional array of string arguments for the command.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory inside the container.

function.name: containers.Logs
function.description: Return the most recent log lines from a container in this sandbox.

name.description: Container name, as returned by containers.List.

tail.description: Number of recent log lines to return.
